query: select t.id as teacher_id, t.academy_id, a.name as academy_name, coalesce(nullif(trim(p.full_name), ''), trim(t.first_name || ' ' || t.last_name)) as teacher_name, coalesce(p.email, t.email) as teacher_email, t.profile_id, g.id as group_id, g.name as group_name, ga.teacher_id as assistant_teacher_id, ap.full_name as assistant_name, ap.email as assistant_email, s.id as student_id, trim(s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name) as student_name, s.email as student_email from public.teachers t join public.academies a on a.id = t.academy_id left join public.profiles p on p.id = t.profile_id left join public.groups g on g.teacher_id = t.id and g.academy_id = t.academy_id left join public.group_assistants ga on ga.group_id = g.id left join public.teachers at on at.id = ga.teacher_id and at.academy_id = t.academy_id left join public.profiles ap on ap.id = at.profile_id left join public.group_students gs on gs.group_id = g.id left join public.students s on s.id = gs.student_id and s.academy_id = t.academy_id order by a.name, teacher_name, group_name, assistant_name, student_name limit 1000
